steps.en: Describe the answer as a Pydantic model; create an agent from a model string
steps.zh: 把想要的答案写成 Pydantic 模型，用一个模型字符串建 Agent

steps.en: Decorate plain Python functions as tools
steps.zh: 给普通 Python 函数贴上装饰器，变成工具

steps.en: Start a run with your prompt
steps.zh: 带着提示词发起一次运行

steps.en: Builds tool schemas from signatures and docstrings, sends them with the prompt
steps.zh: 从函数签名和 docstring 生成工具说明，连同提示词发给模型

steps.en: Validates each tool call's arguments, runs your function, returns the result
steps.zh: 校验每次工具调用的参数，再执行你的函数，把结果交回模型

steps.en: Validates the final answer; on failure sends the error back so the model retries
steps.zh: 校验最终答案，不合格就把错误发回去让模型重答

value.en: result.output is a typed object your IDE and type checker know — no string parsing, and switching provider is a string edit
value.zh: result.output 直接是 IDE 和类型检查器认识的对象，不用再解析字符串；换模型厂商只改一个字符串

sources: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/blob/main/docs/output.md (validation failures and ModelRetry go back to the model as retries; Agent(retries={'output': N}))
